name: button-hover-right
blurb: Icon button expands to show text on hover.
description: A circular icon button that expands horizontally on hover to reveal text alongside the arrow icon. Text fades in as the button width increases.
use_when: A compact icon button that needs to reveal its purpose on hover.
avoid_when: When text should be always visible or in space-constrained layouts.
a11y: Native button with hidden text that only appears on hover, limiting accessibility. Icon is decorative.
